parsed.explanation: The write-up states the required divisor-set equivalence but explicitly omits its proof, and no other passage proves it for all nonnegative α,β. A single sentence suffices: assume without loss of generality α≤β; then (α′,β′)=(α,β−α), and t divides α and β iff it divides α and β−α. This also covers zero and equal valuations. Since all other valuations are unchanged, the gcd of the entire tuple is then invariant.
